siena: FYI during the quant bring-up for the new 4-bit build I'm seeing early streaming termination when the model emits multiple EOS-like tokens in sequence. repro below :thinking:

liam: can you paste a short repro + logs?

siena: repro steps:
1) HF model converted with our hf-to-redwood script (latest main)
2) tokenizer has both `</s>` and `<|endoftext|>` in special tokens, convert ended up mapping only one of them to `eos_token` in config.json
3) quantize with 4-bit config (bnb) and serve with streaming enabled
4) send prompt that ends with a small generation that contains both markers (common for our eval prompts)

observed: the stream closes early after the first subtoken of the multi-token EOS sequence, cutting off the rest of the output. log snippet:
```
[2026-02-12T14:22:11Z] stream: recv chunk id=... content='...\n'
[2026-02-12T14:22:11Z] runtime: found eos token id=50256 -> close stream
[2026-02-12T14:22:11Z] client: partial_answer='We should probably...' (truncated)
```

siena: quick dump of model.config and tokenizer special map (converted output):
```json
{"eos_token": "</s>", "eos_token_id": 2}
{"special_tokens_map": {"eos_token": "</s>"}, "added_tokens": []}
```

maya: sounds like the convert step collapsed multiple eos-like tokens to a single canonical `eos_token` and dropped the alternate sentinel. when the quantized model emits a subtoken sequence that corresponds to the other sentinel, runtime sees the first matching id and stops prematurely.

liam: quick check you can run locally to inspect token ids: 
```py
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path/to/converted')
print(tok.convert_tokens_to_ids(['</s>', '<|endoftext|>']))
print(tok.encode('...<|endoftext|>'))
```
that should show if the two sentinels map to different ids or were merged.

jon: i've opened a tracker and a small patch set. root cause: our hf->redwood converter currently copies `eos_token` and `eos_token_id` but not `special_tokens_map` or `eos_token_ids` list (some tokenizers keep eos as a list). plan: copy over `special_tokens_map`, preserve `added_tokens`, and if tokenizer provides `eos_token_ids` populate `model.config.eos_token_ids` so runtime can check all possibilities. PR 1246.

jon: runtime follow-up: also going to change the streaming stop check to prefer longest-token-sequence match (so multi-token sentinels aren't cut by a single-subtoken match) and add a small unit test for token-boundary streaming.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy of `fix/quant-eos-conv` to eng-runtime at 2026-02-13T03:00Z (no downtime).

devx: for customers hit by this, a short workaround is to pass explicit `stop_sequences` (string-level) from the SDK or set `stream_stop_policy='post_concat'` so server evaluates stop sequences after re-joining subtokens. we'll add a note to the convert docs.

siena: Thanks all — verifying against canary now. will post a tiny failing example (token ids + prompt) if it still repros. :sparkles:
